caption: Global menu bar
description: The focused app's name in bold and its menus: the app's own menus when it exports them, or a standard File, Edit, View, Window and Help set with shortcuts and icons.

caption: Clock panel
description: Click the clock for calendar, weather forecast, notifications, clipboard history, a focus timer and reminders.

caption: Settings
description: Choose the system logo, the bar style, the menus and the clock pages. Every change applies instantly.
